## Checklist

- [ ] `bun test` and `bunx tsc --noEmit` pass
- [ ] A new detection has a selftest case and a benign look-alike, and `vswarm selftest` shows no false alarms
- [ ] No new runtime dependency
- [ ] No credential values in code, tests or output
- [ ] README / guide updated if a command or its output changed
